title: Title & Registration Services Returned Packets Going Back to the State: Policy Entry and System Reference for the Resubmission Tool
content:
## Policy entry

A Title & Registration Services packet that the state has returned goes back to the state with payment: the order is made ready again and submitted on that day in the same action, and the state fees are remitted with it.

A returned packet does not go back to the state until the late-registration penalty named on a fee-shortage return that states no amount stands collected on the order as its own fee entry.

A packet returned for a lien information error goes back to the state only after the lien charges for the corrected lien stand collected on the order as a lien recording fee entry.

Restated in the same terms: while a fee-shortage return of no amount has no late-registration penalty standing collected on the order as its own fee entry, the packet stays with Kestrel; and while a lien information error return has no lien charges standing collected on the order as a lien recording fee entry, the packet stays with Kestrel.

## System reference: `resubmit_title_packet_8a13d7a9`

**Capability.** Sends a title and registration packet that the state returned back to the state, with payment. One call makes the returned order ready again and submits it in the same action, so the order ends as submitted; it stamps that day as the order's most recent submission date with a new state receipt number, books one remittance to the state for the amount passed, dated that day, and clears the state fees held on the order to 0.00. The buyer can see the order as submitted at once.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `title_order_id` | the reference number of the returned title and registration order, as shown by the title and registration order lookup for this buyer before the call | identifier, copied as shown |
| `purchase_order_id` | the reference number of the purchase order the vehicle was bought on, as shown on the title and registration order and by the purchase order lookup before the call | identifier, copied as shown |
| `remit_amount` | the total paid to the state with the packet | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; booked exactly as passed |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` reading `resubmitted` on success, `title_order_id`, `purchase_order_id`, `title_txn_id` (reference number of the remittance entry), `dmv_transaction_number` (the state's receipt number for this submission), `submitted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `remit_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places as booked) and `state_fees_held` (USD with 2 decimal places, 0.00 after the remittance). No error responses are defined for this tool.
